description: Seed ground-truth set for retrieval MRR, covering all terraform_modules/ (9 findings each) plus 5 negative findings (empty relevant_modules) with no matching module. SEED DATA: review and replace with real anonymised findings labelled by a domain expert.

findings.title: S3 general purpose buckets should have block public access settings enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Enable Block Public Access at the account level.

findings.title: S3 general purpose buckets should block public access
findings.recommendation_text: Enable S3 Block Public Access for the bucket.

findings.title: S3 general purpose buckets should block public read access
findings.recommendation_text: Block public read access using Block Public Access settings.

findings.title: S3 general purpose buckets should block public write access
findings.recommendation_text: Block public write access using Block Public Access settings.

findings.title: Ensure that S3 buckets are configured with Block public access (bucket settings)
findings.recommendation_text: Turn on all four Block Public Access options.

findings.title: S3 bucket ACL grants access to AllUsers
findings.recommendation_text: Remove public ACL grants and enable ignore_public_acls.

findings.title: Bucket policy allows public principal on S3 bucket
findings.recommendation_text: Restrict public policies with block_public_policy.

findings.title: Account-level S3 public access is not blocked
findings.recommendation_text: Enable account level S3 public access block.

findings.title: Storage bucket may be publicly readable or writable
findings.recommendation_text: Enable restrict_public_buckets on the bucket.

findings.title: Security groups should not allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22
findings.recommendation_text: Remove the rule allowing SSH from anywhere.

findings.title: Security groups should not allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to remote server administration ports
findings.recommendation_text: Restrict administration ports to known CIDRs.

findings.title: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22
findings.recommendation_text: Limit SSH access to approved sources.

findings.title: Security group allows unrestricted SSH access from the internet
findings.recommendation_text: Replace 0.0.0.0/0 on port 22 with a bastion security group.

findings.title: SSH port 22 open to the world on security group
findings.recommendation_text: Revoke the public ingress rule for tcp/22.

findings.title: Security group permits remote administration over SSH from ::/0
findings.recommendation_text: Remove the IPv6 any-address ingress rule for SSH.

findings.title: Inbound SSH from any IPv4 address detected on security group
findings.recommendation_text: Restrict SSH ingress to the corporate VPN range.

findings.title: Ensure security group does not allow public SSH
findings.recommendation_text: Revoke 0.0.0.0/0 tcp 22 and add an allow-list.

findings.title: Default security group allows port 22 from anywhere
findings.recommendation_text: Constrain SSH ingress rules.

findings.title: EBS default encryption should be enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Enable EBS encryption by default in the region.

findings.title: Ensure EBS volume encryption is enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Turn on default EBS encryption.

findings.title: New EBS volumes are created unencrypted in this region
findings.recommendation_text: Enable encryption by default for EBS volumes.

findings.title: EBS encryption by default is disabled
findings.recommendation_text: Enable ebs encryption by default.

findings.title: Unencrypted EBS volumes can be created in this account
findings.recommendation_text: Enforce regional EBS encryption default with a KMS key.

findings.title: Volumes do not use a customer managed KMS key by default
findings.recommendation_text: Set the EBS default KMS key.

findings.title: Regional EBS data at rest encryption is not enforced
findings.recommendation_text: Enable EBS default encryption.

findings.title: Account allows creation of unencrypted EBS snapshots and volumes
findings.recommendation_text: Turn on EBS encryption by default.

findings.title: Block storage volumes not encrypted by default
findings.recommendation_text: Enable encryption by default at the region level.

findings.title: CloudTrail should be enabled and configured with at least one multi-Region trail
findings.recommendation_text: Create a multi-region trail.

findings.title: CloudTrail log file validation should be enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Enable log file validation on the trail.

findings.title: CloudTrail should have encryption at-rest enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Encrypt trail logs with KMS.

findings.title: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
findings.recommendation_text: Enable a multi-region CloudTrail trail.

findings.title: No CloudTrail trail is logging API activity in this account
findings.recommendation_text: Create and start a CloudTrail trail.

findings.title: Audit logging is not enabled for all regions
findings.recommendation_text: Enable a multi-region audit trail with global service events.

findings.title: CloudTrail trail is not multi-region
findings.recommendation_text: Set is_multi_region_trail to true.

findings.title: Log file integrity validation is disabled on trail
findings.recommendation_text: Turn on enable_log_file_validation.

findings.title: Management events are not captured by any trail
findings.recommendation_text: Deploy a trail delivering to a secured S3 bucket.

findings.title: Password policies for IAM users should have strong configurations
findings.recommendation_text: Strengthen the account password policy.

findings.title: Ensure IAM password policy requires at least one uppercase letter
findings.recommendation_text: Require uppercase characters.

findings.title: Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum password length of 14 or greater
findings.recommendation_text: Set the minimum password length to 14.

findings.title: Ensure IAM password policy prevents password reuse
findings.recommendation_text: Set password reuse prevention to 24.

findings.title: Ensure IAM password policy expires passwords within 90 days or less
findings.recommendation_text: Set maximum password age to 90 days.

findings.title: Ensure IAM password policy requires at least one symbol
findings.recommendation_text: Require symbols in passwords.

findings.title: Account password policy is weak: no complexity requirements
findings.recommendation_text: Require lowercase uppercase numbers and symbols.

findings.title: IAM users can choose short passwords
findings.recommendation_text: Increase minimum password length.

findings.title: Passwords never expire for IAM users
findings.recommendation_text: Enforce password rotation via max_password_age.

findings.title: VPC Flow Logs should be enabled in all VPCs
findings.recommendation_text: Enable VPC Flow Logs delivering to CloudWatch Logs.

findings.title: VPC does not have flow logging enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Create a flow log for the VPC.

findings.title: Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs
findings.recommendation_text: Enable flow logs for network traffic visibility.

findings.title: Network traffic is not being logged for this VPC
findings.recommendation_text: Turn on VPC Flow Logs.

findings.title: No flow log destination configured for VPC
findings.recommendation_text: Deliver flow logs to a CloudWatch Logs group.

findings.title: Flow logging disabled on one or more VPCs
findings.recommendation_text: Enable flow logs for all traffic types.

findings.title: VPC traffic is not auditable due to missing flow logs
findings.recommendation_text: Enable VPC flow logging with an IAM role for delivery.

findings.title: Rejected connections are not visible due to missing flow logs
findings.recommendation_text: Enable flow logs capturing REJECT or ALL traffic.

findings.title: Default VPC has no flow log
findings.recommendation_text: Create a flow log for the default VPC.

findings.title: GuardDuty should be enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Enable the GuardDuty detector for this account and region.

findings.title: No threat detection service is enabled in this account
findings.recommendation_text: Enable GuardDuty.

findings.title: Ensure GuardDuty is enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Enable the GuardDuty detector.

findings.title: GuardDuty detector is not configured for this region
findings.recommendation_text: Create a GuardDuty detector.

findings.title: Malicious activity would go undetected due to disabled GuardDuty
findings.recommendation_text: Turn on GuardDuty threat detection.

findings.title: Intelligent threat detection is disabled
findings.recommendation_text: Enable GuardDuty with S3 protection.

findings.title: Account has no active GuardDuty findings pipeline
findings.recommendation_text: Enable GuardDuty to begin generating findings.

findings.title: GuardDuty is suspended or never enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Enable the GuardDuty detector for continuous monitoring.

findings.title: No automated threat detection configured for account
findings.recommendation_text: Enable GuardDuty detector.

findings.title: VPC default security group should prohibit inbound and outbound traffic
findings.recommendation_text: Remove all ingress and egress rules from the default security group.

findings.title: Default security group allows traffic
findings.recommendation_text: Lock down the default security group to deny all traffic.

findings.title: Ensure the default security group restricts all traffic
findings.recommendation_text: Revoke all rules from the default security group.

findings.title: Default VPC security group has permissive rules
findings.recommendation_text: Strip all ingress/egress rules from the default SG.

findings.title: Unused default security group still allows traffic
findings.recommendation_text: Adopt and lock down the default security group.

findings.title: Default security group is not restricted
findings.recommendation_text: Remove default allow rules on the default security group.

findings.title: Resources accidentally placed in default SG may have open access
findings.recommendation_text: Lock down the default security group.

findings.title: Default security group allows all outbound traffic
findings.recommendation_text: Remove the default egress rule.

findings.title: VPC default security group not hardened per baseline
findings.recommendation_text: Apply the default security group lockdown.

findings.title: S3 general purpose buckets should have server-side encryption configured
findings.recommendation_text: Enable default server-side encryption on the bucket.

findings.title: S3 bucket has no default encryption configuration
findings.recommendation_text: Enable SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS default encryption.

findings.title: Ensure S3 bucket default encryption is enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Configure default server-side encryption.

findings.title: Objects uploaded without encryption would be stored in clear text
findings.recommendation_text: Enable default bucket encryption.

findings.title: S3 bucket server-side encryption is not configured
findings.recommendation_text: Apply a default encryption configuration to the bucket.

findings.title: Bucket lacks SSE-KMS or SSE-S3 default encryption
findings.recommendation_text: Set apply_server_side_encryption_by_default.

findings.title: Data at rest in S3 bucket is not encrypted by default
findings.recommendation_text: Turn on default encryption for the bucket.

findings.title: S3 bucket missing encryption configuration
findings.recommendation_text: Configure AES256 or aws:kms default encryption.

findings.title: New objects in bucket are not automatically encrypted
findings.recommendation_text: Enable default server-side encryption.

findings.title: S3 general purpose buckets should have versioning enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Enable versioning on the bucket to protect against accidental deletion.

findings.title: S3 bucket versioning is disabled
findings.recommendation_text: Enable bucket versioning.

findings.title: Accidental object overwrite cannot be recovered due to missing versioning
findings.recommendation_text: Turn on versioning for the bucket.

findings.title: Bucket does not retain prior object versions
findings.recommendation_text: Enable versioning_configuration with status Enabled.

findings.title: Object recovery is not possible because versioning is off
findings.recommendation_text: Enable S3 bucket versioning.

findings.title: S3 bucket has no protection against accidental deletion
findings.recommendation_text: Enable versioning on the bucket.

findings.title: Versioning not enabled on bucket storing critical data
findings.recommendation_text: Turn on bucket versioning.

findings.title: Bucket lacks rollback capability for overwritten objects
findings.recommendation_text: Enable versioning.

findings.title: S3 bucket versioning configuration missing
findings.recommendation_text: Apply an Enabled versioning configuration.

findings.title: IAM Access Analyzer should be enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Enable an account-zone IAM Access Analyzer.

findings.title: No IAM Access Analyzer is enabled for the account
findings.recommendation_text: Create an Access Analyzer.

findings.title: Ensure IAM Access Analyzer is enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Enable Access Analyzer for the account.

findings.title: Externally shared resources would go undetected without Access Analyzer
findings.recommendation_text: Enable an Access Analyzer to detect external access.

findings.title: Account zone of trust is not monitored by Access Analyzer
findings.recommendation_text: Create an ACCOUNT type Access Analyzer.

findings.title: Resource-based policy exposure is not monitored
findings.recommendation_text: Enable IAM Access Analyzer.

findings.title: No analyzer configured to detect resources shared outside the account
findings.recommendation_text: Enable Access Analyzer.

findings.title: IAM Access Analyzer has never been created
findings.recommendation_text: Create an account-level Access Analyzer.

findings.title: Unintended external access findings are not being generated
findings.recommendation_text: Enable IAM Access Analyzer for the account.

findings.title: RDS DB instances should have deletion protection enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Enable deletion protection.

findings.title: AWS KMS key rotation should be enabled
findings.recommendation_text: Enable automatic key rotation.

findings.title: Lambda functions should use supported runtimes
findings.recommendation_text: Upgrade the function runtime.

findings.title: Application Load Balancer should be configured to redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS
findings.recommendation_text: Add an HTTP to HTTPS redirect listener rule.

findings.title: DynamoDB tables should automatically scale capacity with demand
findings.recommendation_text: Enable auto scaling or on-demand mode.
